parts.name: deck board

physics.Basic_description: A flat, elongated wooden board with rounded ends and a light tan finish, featuring visible mounting holes.
physics.Functional_description: The main platform for the rider to stand on, providing structural support and flex.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the side edges or the top surface firmly with parallel jaws; the flat geometry offers stable contact.
physics.reason: Skateboard decks are constructed from laminated layers of solid wood veneer, making them effectively solid throughout their thickness.

sourceAnnotations.semantic_description: The T-shaped metal component that holds the axle and wheels, pivoting on the kingpin.
sourceAnnotations.Basic_description: The T-shaped metal component that holds the axle and wheels, pivoting on the kingpin.
sourceAnnotations.Functional_description: Connects the wheels to the baseplate and enables turning via the bushings.
sourceAnnotations.Grasped_description: Grasp the central body or axle ends; robust enough for manipulation.

physics.reason: Cast aluminum hangers often have internal voids or thin walls to save weight while maintaining strength, though some are solid; modeled as thick-walled hollow to be safe.

sourceAnnotations.semantic_description: The inner core of the wheel, typically made of hard plastic or urethane, visible inside the tire.
sourceAnnotations.Basic_description: The inner core of the wheel, typically made of hard plastic or urethane, visible inside the tire.
sourceAnnotations.Functional_description: Provides structural support for the soft outer tire and houses the bearing.
sourceAnnotations.Grasped_description: Difficult to grasp directly without touching the tire; usually grasped via the tire.

physics.reason: Wheel cores are generally solid plastic or urethane inserts.

sourceAnnotations.Grasped_description: Ideal grasp point; pinch the wheel sides or wrap around the circumference.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
